titulo.alumno: «Disse que estava cansado»: he said he was tired

intro: Read the text and interpret questions and statements reported with changes of person and tense.

palabras.significado: In context: Sofia said she was tired because she had worked late.
In context: They asked her whether she would come back the next day.
In context: They asked her whether she would come back the next day.
In context: She replied that she hadn't decided yet.

texto: Interpret questions and statements reported with changes of person and tense.
Compare the literal information with the purpose of the text; don't add details that don't appear.
